scenarios.prompt: A cold repository and pull request need orientation and a concise summary before any specialized workflow is selected.
Acquire unresolved review threads and stop at an authorized response-only outcome without changing resolution state.
A mixed worktree needs task-owned checkpointing, a verified push, and draft publication through the bound workflow.
A request to create a pull request through a direct connector or gh pr create --fill collides with the bound publisher and must be refused.
The retained gh-fix-ci specialist stays independently updateable and is limited to GitHub Actions diagnosis and repair.
